newsitem.title: USA: City Auto buys back shrs held by Cityscape.
newsitem.headline: City Auto buys back shrs held by Cityscape.

text.p: City Auto Resource Services Inc said Monday it had repurchased the five million share stake in its stock held by Cityscape Financial Corp.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

A company spokesman said in a press release that "both parties agreed that the proposed arrangement was not feasible. Our company has made alternative provisions for services it had hoped to obtain from Cityscape Financial."

City Auto is a recently formed finance company that deals in non-prime automobile loans. It said that it had met with Cityscape at the time of its formation to discuss the possibility of Cityscape providing it with services.
The company did not specify the services discussed.
Cityscape originates and processes non-prime mortgage loans.
The repurchase reduces the number of common shares outstanding to 9,259,261, City Auto said.
